') center top/cover no-repeat!important; }
body::before { content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,7,14,.6),rgba(0,7,14,.1) 55%,rgba(0,7,14,.42));pointer-events:none; }
body::after {box-shadow:inset 0 -30px 70px #020811!important;border:0!important;}
.app {display:block!important;padding:0!important;}
.app>header,.holo-wrap,#particles,.nexus-subtle-starfield,.nexus-chat-starfield,.nexus-shooting-star,.nexus-balanced-starfield,#taskRestore {display:none!important;}
#bladeHeader {position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:8vh;min-height:54px;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 3vw;background:#030a12;border-bottom:1px solid #789bb5;color:#e2effb;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:12px;}
#bladeHeader strong {font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.5em;} #bladeHeader small {color:#90b7d3;letter-spacing:.3em;margin-left:22px;}
#bladeHeader button {color:#b5d9eb!important;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0;cursor:pointer;}
#bladeTitle {position:fixed;left:5.4vw;top:23vh;z-index:4;width:33vw;pointer-events:none;}
#bladeTitle .kanji {font-family:serif;font-size:clamp(46px,6vw,100px);color:#9db1c7;opacity:.66;line-height:1;}
#bladeTitle h1 {margin:14px 0;font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,48px);font-style:italic;letter-spacing:.16em;white-space:nowrap;color:#e5f4ff;}
#bladeTitle h1 em {color:#8dcaff;font-style:inherit;} #bladeTitle .subtitle {font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.5em;color:#a6bbcf;}
#bladeTitle .rule {margin:20px 0;width:90%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9adfff,transparent);}
.blade-stages {display:grid;gap:12px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:#a3b3c4;}
.blade-stages span::before {content:'//';color:#729cc0;margin-right:14px;} [data-active="true"] {color:#9ceeff!important;text-shadow:0 0 12px #62bdff;}
#bladeCenter {position:fixed;left:50%;top:5vh;width:0;height:78vh;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;}
#bladeSword {position:absolute;height:100%;width:auto;max-width:none;left:calc(-78vh * .4 * .29);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(137,201,255,.48));transition:filter .3s;}
#bladeCenter[data-speaking="true"] #bladeSword {filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #bdefff) drop-shadow(0 0 28px #328dff);}
#bladeSpiral {position:absolute;top:22%;left:-10vw;width:20vw;height:70%;overflow:visible;opacity:.25;transition:opacity .3s;}
#bladeSpiral path {fill:none;stroke:#a8dfff;stroke-width:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #46b9ff);stroke-dasharray:85 15;stroke-dashoffset:0;}
#bladeCenter[data-thinking="true"] #bladeSpiral {opacity:1;} #bladeCenter[data-thinking="true"] #bladeSpiral path {animation:bladeFlow 3s linear infinite;}
@keyframes bladeFlow {to{stroke-dashoffset:-200;}}
#bladeRipples {position:fixed;left:43%;top:78%;width:15%;height:3%;border:1px solid #b5e3ff66;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;animation:bladeRipple 7s ease-out infinite;z-index:2;}
@keyframes bladeRipple {0%{transform:scale(.75);opacity:.1}50%{opacity:.35}100%{transform:scale(1.3);opacity:.05}}
#taskPanel {position:fixed!important;left:auto!important;right:2vw!important;top:10vh!important;width:23vw!important;height:64vh!important;max-height:none!important;padding:20px!important;z-index:6!important;background:rgba(2,12,23,.86)!important;border:1px solid #86b7d1!important;border-radius:14px!important;overflow:auto!important;display:block!important;}
#taskPanel> *:not(#bladeSystem) {display:none!important;}
#bladeSystem {font-size:12px;color:#c7dbea;letter-spacing:.06em;} #bladeSystem h2 {font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:500;margin:0 0 20px;color:#e8f5ff;}
#bladeSystem dl {margin:0 0 22px;} #bladeSystem dl div {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #43617a66;} #bladeSystem dt {color:#b4cbde;font-size:11px;} #bladeSystem dd {margin:0;text-align:right;font-size:11px;}
#bladeSystem .section {margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid #5a7c9466;padding-top:17px;}
#bladeTasks {display:grid;gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px;color:#839fb7;} #bladeTasks span::before{content:'◇';margin-right:10px;}
#bladeNow {color:#cce5f6;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-height:5em;overflow:auto;}
#bladeSystem button {color:#a9dfff;background:transparent;border:1px solid #638da7;border-radius:4px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer;}
.console {position:fixed!important;left:20%!important;top:75%!important;width:54%!important;height:9.5%!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;display:block!important;padding:10px 18px!important;background:rgba(3,17,33,.78)!important;border:1px solid #89cbf3!important;border-radius:10px!important;z-index:12!important;overflow:hidden!important;}
.console-head,#detailBox {display:none!important;}
#log {height:100%!important;max-height:none!important;overflow-y:auto!important;display:block!important;padding:0!important;}
#log:empty::before {content:'NEXUS　ご命令をお待ちしています。';color:#adc6dd;font-size:13px;}
#log .msg {display:block!important;font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.55!important;margin:0 0 4px!important;padding:0!important;color:#d9ebfa!important;}
#log .msg small {display:inline!important;margin-right:14px!important;color:#75d7ff!important;font-weight:bold;}
.input-area {position:fixed!important;left:20%!important;top:87%!important;bottom:auto!important;width:60%!important;height:7vh!important;min-height:48px!important;z-index:15!important;background:rgba(4,16,30,.88)!important;border:1px solid #b3deff!important;border-radius:14px!important;box-shadow:0 0 16px #70c4ff55!important;}
.composer {height:100%!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;padding:0 12px!important;gap:10px!important;}
#typingStatus {position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;display:block!important;flex:1!important;width:auto!important;height:100%!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:100%!important;overflow:auto!important;padding:12px 6px!important;color:#e7f5ff!important;font-size:16px!important;white-space:pre-wrap!important;}
#typingStatus:empty::before {content:'Message NEXUS KATANA…'!important;color:#a1b6cb!important;}
#micBtn,#kanaBtn,#bladeSend {position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;display:block!important;flex:none!important;color:#b8e5ff!important;font-size:16px!important;padding:8px!important;cursor:pointer;}
#bladeSend {border:0;background:transparent;font-size:24px!important;}
#command {display:none!important;}
#bladeFooter {position:fixed;bottom:2.5vh;left:3%;width:94%;text-align:center;letter-spacing:1em;font-size:9px;color:#adc9df;border-bottom:1px solid #749ab666;pointer-events:none;}
@media(max-width:1050px){#bladeHeader small{display:none;}#bladeTitle{left:3vw;width:32vw}#taskPanel{width:27vw!important;padding:12px!important;}#bladeSystem{font-size:11px;}#bladeSystem h2{font-size:11px;}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#bladeSpiral path,#bladeRipples{animation:none!important;}}
/* 元テーマの透過率を新しい実情報欄には引き継がない。 */
#taskPanel,#bladeSystem,#bladeSystem * {opacity:1!important;}
#bladeSystem,#bladeSystem h2,#bladeSystem dd,#bladeNow {color:#d9edfb!important;}
#bladeSystem dt,#bladeTasks span {color:#b5cede!important;}
#bladeTasks [data-active="true"] {color:#9ceeff!important;}
#log:not(:has(.msg))::before {content:'NEXUS　ご命令をお待ちしています。'!important;display:block!important;color:#c9e1f3!important;font-size:13px!important;}
#typingStatus:has(>br:only-child)::before {content:'Message NEXUS KATANA…'!important;color:#a1b6cb!important;}
#bladeCenter {top:8vh;height:74vh;}
#bladeSword {left:calc(-74vh * .4 * .29);}
@media(max-height:800px){
 #taskPanel{padding:14px!important;}
 #bladeSystem h2{font-size:12px;margin-bottom:10px;}
 #bladeSystem dl{margin-bottom:8px;} #bladeSystem dl div{padding:5px 0;}
 #bladeSystem .section{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;}
 #bladeTasks{gap:7px;margin-bottom:10px;} #bladeNow{max-height:3.2em;}
}
</style>
